asset.name: CommandPalette
asset.description: The global or scoped command interface with fuzzy search, recent actions, categories, keyboard navigation, argument collection, async execution, and command history.

requires.reason: Modal presentation, focus, and dismissal are shared.
Commands come from one registry shared with menus and toolbars.
Invocation and per-command shortcuts resolve through one collision-aware registry.
Query entry, debouncing, and cancellation are shared.

signatureMoment.description: The palette opens already focused with recent commands present, so a returning user completes a frequent action in two keystrokes without reading the list.

rationale: Worth building as the visible front end of the shared command registry rather than an isolated modal: the same registrations should drive menus, toolbars, shortcut hints, and agent-invoked actions.
